_comment: Hand-entered 2026 Miami draft order. Miami has no live Google Sheet sync (Yahoo API blocked) -- Sean reports the order directly and this file is updated by hand, same as league_rules.json / miami_roster_snapshot_2025.json's confirmed_keepers block. Manager names must match leagues.miami.teams[].manager in bigboard.json exactly, or convert_bigboard.py will flag them as unmatched instead of guessing.
manager_note: Sean referred to the 'J White' manager informally as 'Jeff' when reporting this order -- mapped here to 'J White' to match the label used everywhere else (bigboard.json, miami_roster_snapshot_2025.json). Flag if this mapping is wrong.
